remarks.zh: 计算橱柜的板材尺寸。[宽度]、[高度]、[深度] 是总测量，[板厚度] 是顶部、底部和侧板的材质厚度，[背景板厚度] 是背景板的材质厚度。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.en: Calculates board sizes for a cabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] is total measurement, [BoardThick] is Top, Bottom and Side Board material thickness, [BackBoardThick] is Background Board material thickness. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.ms: Mengira saiz papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] adalah ukuran keseluruhan, [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan atas, bawah dan sisi, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.id: Menghitung ukuran papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] adalah total pengukuran, [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan atas, bawah, dan samping, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.th: คำนวณขนาดบอร์ดสำหรับตู้ [Width], [Height], [Depth] คือการวัดทั้งหมด [BoardThick] คือความหนาของวัสดุแผ่นด้านบน ด้านล่าง และด้านข้าง [BackBoardThick] คือความหนาของวัสดุแผ่นด้านหลัง (AI translated, please check)
remarks.vi: Tính toán kích thước bảng cho tủ. [Width], [Height], [Depth] là kích thước tổng, [BoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu của bảng Trên, Dưới và Bên, [BackBoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu của bảng nền. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.tl: Kinakalkula ang mga sukat ng kahoy para sa kabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] ay kabuuang sukat, [BoardThick] ay kapal ng materyal ng Itaas, Ibaba, at Gilid na Kahoy, [BackBoardThick] ay kapal ng materyal ng Likurang Kahoy. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.my: အိတ်များအတွက်ဘောင်အရွယ်အစားများကိုတွက်ချက်ပါ။ [Width], [Height], [Depth] သည်စုစုပေါင်းတိုင်းတာချက်ဖြစ်ပြီး [BoardThick] သည်အထက်၊ အောက်နှင့်ဘေးဘောင်ပစ္စည်းအထူဖြစ်သည်၊ [BackBoardThick] သည်နောက်မှတ်တိုင်ပစ္စည်းအထူဖြစ်သည်။ (AI translated, please check)
remarks.km: គណនាទំហំបន្ទះសម្រាប់ទូ [Width], [Height], [Depth] គឺជារង្វាស់សរុប [BoardThick] គឺជាភ្លឺវត្ថុធាតុបន្ថែមពីលើ សន្ទះបាតនិងសន្ទះមួយចំហៀង [BackBoardThick] គឺជាភ្លឺវត្ថុធាតុសន្ទះខាងក្រោយ។ (AI translated, please check)
remarks.lo: ຄິດໄລຍະທາງຂອງບອດສຳລັບຕູ້ [ Width ], [ Height ], [ Depth ] ແມ່ນສ່ວນລວມຂອງສ້ອມ ຫນາຜິວ, [ BoardThick ] ແມ່ນຄວາມຫນາຮາຍການຂອງ ທາງ(banarente aguination modify, please check))
remarks.ja: キャビネットの板材サイズを計算します。[Width]、[Height]、[Depth]は全体の寸法で、[BoardThick]は上板、下板、側板の厚さ、[BackBoardThick]は背面板の材質の厚さです。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.ko: 캐비닛의 보드 크기를 계산합니다. [Width], [Height], [Depth]는 전체 치수이며, [BoardThick]는 상판, 하판 및 측판의 재질 두께, [BackBoardThick]는 배경 판의 재질 두께입니다. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.es: Calcula los tamaños de los tableros para un armario. [Width], [Height], [Depth] son medidas totales, [BoardThick] es el grosor del material de los tableros superior, inferior y laterales, [BackBoardThick] es el grosor del material del tablero trasero. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.fr: Calcule les dimensions des panneaux pour une armoire. [Width], [Height], [Depth] correspondent aux dimensions totales, [BoardThick] est l'épaisseur du matériau des panneaux supérieur, inférieur et latéraux, [BackBoardThick] est l'épaisseur du matériau du panneau arrière. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.de: Berechnet die Plattengrößen für einen Schrank. [Width], [Height], [Depth] sind die Gesamtmaße, [BoardThick] ist die Materialstärke der Ober-, Unter- und Seitenplatten, [BackBoardThick] ist die Materialstärke der Rückwand. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.hi: कैबिनेट के लिए बोर्ड का आकार निर्धारित करता है। [Width], [Height], [Depth] कुल माप है, [BoardThick] शीर्ष, निचले और साइड बोर्ड सामग्री की मोटाई है, [BackBoardThick] पृष्ठभूमि बोर्ड सामग्री की मोटाई है। (AI translated, please check)
remarks.ru: Рассчитывает размеры досок для шкафа. [Width], [Height], [Depth] — это общие размеры, [BoardThick] — это толщина материала для верхней, нижней и боковой доски, [BackBoardThick] — это толщина материала задней доски. (AI translated, please check)
